mapper.select:
select stl.ACCT_NO as accountId, stl.ACCT_NAME as accountName, B.ACCT_TYPE as accountType from STL_CAPACCT_INFO stl LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO B on stl.ACCT_NO=B.ACCT_NO where B.ACCT_TYPE is not null
and ACCT_TYPE in
#{item}
AND (stl.ACCT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR stl.ACCT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')

select DISTINCT stl.ACCT_NO code, stl.ACCT_NAME name, stl.ACCT_NAME shortName, stl.ACCT_NO hidCode, stl.ACCT_NAME linkValue from STL_CAPACCT_INFO stl LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO B on stl.ACCT_NO=B.ACCT_NO where B.ACCT_TYPE is not null
and ACCT_TYPE in
#{item}
AND (stl.ACCT_NO like '%' || #{accountId} || '%' OR stl.ACCT_NAME like '%' || #{accountId} || '%')

select stl.ACCT_NO as accountId, stl.ACCT_NAME as accountName, B.ACCT_TYPE as accountType from STL_CAPACCT_INFO stl LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO B on stl.ACCT_NO=B.ACCT_NO where B.ACCT_TYPE is not null and ACCT_TYPE=#{accountType}

select count(1)
from FIN_RATE_INFO where CASH_ID=#{cashId} and EFF_DATE=to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
